changelog:
A proper assistant in your pocket.

New bottom navigation. Documents and Calendar used to be two tiny unlabelled icons in the corner of one screen; everything now has a labelled tab you can reach from anywhere.

New Day tab: your plan for today, and timers. Timers keep running with the app closed - they go off even if you swipe the app away or lock the phone.

New People tab: everyone you deal with, with their number and email. Tap someone to see what you owe them, what they owe you, and the meetings you've had - and it understands nicknames, so looking up "Bob" finds everything filed under Robert Chen too.

New Search tab: search everything your PC has indexed - screen history, documents, meeting transcripts and messages. Needs your PC awake, and says so plainly when it isn't.

Daily briefs: your phone can write you a morning summary and give you a heads-up before planned work. Set the times in Settings. Your phone writes these itself and schedules them locally - nothing is sent to a server to make them happen.

Also: searching your documents now looks inside them, not just at their filenames.
